conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Agile teams commonly use daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to manage continuous feedback and adapt their processes. These ceremonies provide regular opportunities for team members to sync up and address any issues.

conversation.message: That's really helpful. Do you think those methods are suitable for remote teams as well?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, these methods are highly suitable for remote teams, often facilitated by collaboration tools for virtual stand-ups and reviews. Many remote teams successfully implement Agile practices to maintain communication and progress.
